WolfPack_Menace


  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned

Toggle - Aimbot apparently

 
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.

I have never used Aimbot in my life, I do not own any hacks or anything like that. My banner (Petlas) has really bad judgement and please tell me how I, a player who has played in Avicus with Admins/Sr.Mods/Mods and Managers (Previously) had never been punished before but now get punished, it is simply silly for him to ban me for something I have never used or had. I would if possible like to file a complaint. I do not own any sort of Hacks, I have put a lot in this server (effort and time) I wouldn't hack it would be dumb. 

Thanks, I guess
